title: BD Onclarity HPV Assay on the BD COR Instrument: Self-collected Vaginal Swabs Validation
official: BD Onclarity HPV Assay on the BD COR Instrument: a Performance Analysis Comparing Two Self-collected Vaginal Swabs From Volunteer IU Health Pathology Laboratory Team Members for Laboratory Validation
summary: This study is being done to help IU Health validate a new method for HPV testing using self-collected vaginal swab samples. Volunteers will collect two vaginal swabs during a single study visit. The test results from these samples will be compared to results from an already validated collection method to make sure the new testing process performs as expected. The information gathered will be used for laboratory validation and will not be used for medical care or reported back to participants.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Persons with a vagina and cervix.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Absence of vagina or cervix or refusal to participate in the study, pregnancy.
